In a SHTF situation, booze will be an immediate liability if your plan is to transport a sizable amount to your bug out location. It would be more sound to plan ahead with your team and set up a small scale brewery or distillery at your bug out location. Once you open your pack, after packing them if that's how you like them, turn all the cigarettes upside down with the butts on the bottom of the pack and the tips on the top. This will keep the menthol inside the cigarettes fresher. Oxygen immediately begins to kill anything it comes into contact with, it's called oxidation. If you're someone who packs their cigs then you can twist the tops of the cigs to reduce the amount of oxygen that gets into the tobacco there as well. That will keep the tobacco fresher. It will also make it extremely easy to pull the cigs out of the pack.

If you smoke Camel Crush cigs, well, this is more of a preference tip. Crush the capsule, then go through the same process. While it's true the capsule keeps the menthol as fresh as can be expected, when I used to occasionally smoke them I noticed unless I crushed the capsule well before I smoked it, the cig didn't really have the full flavor from the menthol. That's because if you crush it and smoke it right away the menthol doesn't have time to fully saturated the filter. :)

Finally, you should strongly consider rolling your own cigs. If for no other reason than it's a fraction of the cost of buying cigarettes at the store. I can make 2-3 cartoons worth of high quality cigarettes for around 15-17 dollars depending on which filters tubes I buy. :) A spoon fed electronic cigarette injection machine makes it pretty easy and relatively fast to make a pack, less than 5 mins. The initial investment in one of those machines will pay for itself in a month give or take depending on how much you smoke. Also, the rolling tobacco itself has much less additives put in them.

So, my adult children who smoke, listen to The Son of God, be sure to smoke your cigs to keep that nasty oxygen out of your lungs as much as possible. You'll live much longer trust me. You'll even cough up some of the garbage that's killing you inside your lungs, the hardened plaque and calcium deposits. :) Smoke if you've got 'em.
